extracted.intended_audience: writers, editors, and journalism students (news reporters and copy editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and standards for writing and editing news copy according to The Associated Press style, covering grammar, usage, legal issues, captions, and filing practices for newsroom use. Intended to help reporters and editors produce clear, consistent journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear writing (overall style aim)
rubrics_metrics.description: AP style defines clear writing as the overarching goal of its rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Noted that more people write for The Associated Press than any single newspaper and that its style defines clear writing; the book presents entries to enforce that aim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing grammatical usage in news copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book presents more than 5,000 entries that present AP's rules on grammar (along with spelling and punctuation usage).

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Preferred spellings and word forms for news reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included among the AP's rules in the book's 5,000+ entries on grammar, spelling, and punctuation usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for punctuation in AP-style copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the core AP rules described in the book's entries on grammar, spelling, and punctuation usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business reporting style
rubrics_metrics.description: Style and usage guidance specific to reporting business news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book contains extra sections about reporting business (in addition to general style entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports reporting style
rubrics_metrics.description: Style and usage guidance specific to reporting sports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book contains extra sections about reporting sport (in addition to general style entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Libel and slander (libel manual)
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal guidance and standards for avoiding libel and handling related legal issues in news copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book presents a libel manual to guide writers and editors on libel/slander issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and practices regarding copyright in journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book includes copyright guidelines to inform use and reproduction of material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) information
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance about the Freedom of Information Act relevant to reporting and public-records requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book provides information on the Freedom of Information Act to assist reporters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo caption style
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and conventions for writing photo captions in AP style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book contains style guidelines for photo captions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and conventions for filing copy within a newsroom or newswire environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book provides guidance on filing practices to help standardize newsroom workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial handling of copy
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidelines for editors to process, edit, and manage copy efficiently and effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes 'guidelines to help editors handle copy easily and efficiently,' intended to streamline editorial work.
